europe_now.title: Russian strike on Kyiv warehouse causes casualties
europe_now.summary: A Russian strike hit a warehouse near Kyiv, killing at least 27 people and prompting hundreds to evacuate. Ukrainian officials said the warehouse was used to store munitions.

sources.headline: 🔴 Russian strike on warehouse near Kyiv kills at least 27 people, hundreds evacuating
At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot

europe_now.title: Dutch institute warns of fatal Trump-shaped ecstasy pills
europe_now.summary: The Dutch drug institute issued a red alert warning that ecstasy pills shaped like former U.S. President Donald Trump can be fatal. The alert highlights the risk of severe harm or death from consuming these illicit substances.

sources.headline: Trump-shaped ecstasy pills can be fatal, Dutch drug institute warns

top_stories.title: Icelanders vote on resuming EU membership negotiations
top_stories.summary: Icelanders voted on whether to resume negotiations for European Union membership. The referendum was described as a pivotal decision for the country's future direction.

sources.headline: Referendum on EU membership: An ‘existential question’ for Icelanders
Iceland votes on whether to resume EU membership negotiations

top_stories.title: Norway's new king addresses nation after succession
top_stories.summary: Norway's newly crowned monarch delivered his first public address following the death of his father. In the speech, he expressed personal grief and emphasized continuity for the nation.

sources.headline: Norway's new king remembers 'my dear father' in first speech

top_stories.title: EU mandates multilingual support for AI chatbots
top_stories.summary: EU regulators decided that AI chatbots operating within the bloc must support all official languages. The rule aims to ensure linguistic inclusivity and accessibility for users across member states.

sources.headline: AI chatbots need to work in all EU languages, not just English
